allow_networks.description: List of IP subnets or hostnames allowed to query this chrony instance as an NTP server.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP server.

iburst.description: Enable fast initial synchronization with burst of packets.

prefer.description: Mark this server as preferred (used as a secondary source if others fail).

ntp_servers.description: List of NTP servers to synchronize with. Each entry defines a server hostname and optional flags.

pps_enabled.description: Enable Pulse Per Second (PPS) reference for high-precision timing, e.g., from GPS receiver.

pps_refid.description: Reference ID string (max 4 chars) to identify the PPS source in logs and status.

pps_precision.description: Expected precision of the PPS signal in seconds (e.g., 1e-9 for nanoseconds).

ntp_auth_enabled.description: Enable NTP authentication using keys in chrony.keys file.

maxdistance.description: Maximum distance to a synchronization source (seconds); sources farther away are rejected.

minsources.description: Minimum number of valid sources required before synchronization is allowed.

sourcereplacementthreshold.description: Threshold (in seconds) for replacing the current reference source (0 = use default).

initstepslew.description: Enable initial time step at startup (use with initstepslew_threshold).

initstepslew_threshold.description: Maximum clock offset (seconds) to allow step-based initial sync.

initstepslew_hosts.description: List of hosts to consider as time sources during initial slew.

ntp_server_enabled.description: Enable this host to serve time to other NTP clients.

local_stratum.description: Stratum level when serving time locally (only effective if ntp_server_enabled is true).

offline_mode.description: Disable all internet time sources — useful for air-gapped or offline systems.

bind_interfaces.description: List of IP addresses or interface names to bind NTP commands and queries to (for security).

manual_allowed.description: Allow use of 'manpage' (chronyc manual control) for debugging/administration.

ntp_broadcast_enabled.description: Enable broadcast of time to local subnet (requires ntp_broadcast_addr).
